senses.gloss: m. (קָשָׁה) protracted travailing, laws of cleanness concerning discharges during protracted travailing.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 4:5">Nidd. IV, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Niddah 36b:7">36ᵇ</cite>) <he>כמה הוא קִשּׁוּיָהּ</he> (Bab. ed. <he>היא קִישּׁ׳</he>) how long may her travailing last (in order to apply to her the laws concerning &c.)?; <cite ref="Yevamot 83a:8">Yeb. 83ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. IV, 6ᵃ; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 1:3:5">Y. Nidd. I, 49ᵇ</cite> top <he>קִישּׁוּיָיהּ</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 1:3:5">ib.</cite> <he>אין ק׳ יותר וכ׳</he> the laws apply only during two weeks. Bab.
Nidd. 66ᵃ אין ק׳ לנפלים the law of ḳishshuy does not apply to cases of abortion; a. e.
